picks.name: Luca Durán
picks.source_note: New artist discovery on TraTraTrax (already followed). Similar Latin/bass-adjacent electronic territory to your Mzansi Bass pick.
picks.bio: "Killing Mariposas" (September 18, 2026, TraTraTrax) is Luca Duran's full studio album debut on the label -- nine tracks combining field recordings, analogue synthesis and experimental production with fragments of cumbia, reggaeton and dembow, featuring Debit, Gavsborg, Rosa Pistola, Iceboy_Violet and kacha.
picks.why_listen: A dense, textural record that folds Latin American rhythm fragments into ambient/techno production -- interesting transitional or afters material with real depth.

picks.name: Ploy
picks.source_note: Already in your library. New remix, not a repeat of the Sept 11 pick.
picks.bio: Already in your library. "Remixes - 3" (September 11, 2026, Timedance) opens with Verraco's reshape of Ploy's 2018 track 'Ramos' -- moulding it into a fierce, forward-charging techno weapon with a futurism-laced euphoria.
picks.why_listen: A classic Ploy cut retooled into a driving peak-time techno tool by Verraco -- immediate dancefloor impact from a trusted catalogue.
